title: DDR, decision discussion record
description: A question put to the owner: its context, 2 to 4 options, each with what it leads to, the recommended one first with why, single or multiple choice, 'other' always possible, their answer, then the read and applied stamps of the model in charge. The ADR keeps the decision that comes out of it when the answer changes a rule, a process or the architecture (Q4). One YAML file per DDR: records/ddr/<id>.yaml.

kind.description: The entry's kind in the owner's queue (default decision). decision: a choice among 2 to 4 options. action (only the owner may do it: keys, money, arming, visibility, legal reading) and permission (the agent lacks a permission: grant a narrow allow rule, or the owner does it once) share the record and its lifecycle; they come with wi-brain-human-queue.

guard.description: The refusal of the owner or power guard this action queues (brain queue add --guard): its exact command is the question (and the command when the owner's Apply runs it), and its ledger entry leaves the queue.

option.description: Label of the recommended option, the first one; null only for a question captured without one.

other_allowed.description: 'Other' with free text is always possible; false only when a question forbids it.

minutes.description: The owner's effort in minutes (brain queue ranks the quick ones a little higher); default: a decision's reading time, 5 for an action, 1 for a permission.

command.description: An action's exact command, the one the owner's Apply runs after showing it (brain queue apply, the cockpit's A): brain ... or install.ps1 ...; run in cwd, else the project's root.

cwd.description: The folder the command runs in, when it is not the project's root.

status.description: pending -> answered (the owner chose or wrote) -> integrated (the model in charge read and applied it) -> archived.

host_id.description: The desktop app's id of that session (CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_SESSION_ID), stamped by the brain commands (scale study gap 19); brain check refuses one that matches no session.

machine.description: The machine the stamp was written on ($BRAIN_HOST, else the host name), so brain check knows where its host_id can be checked.

via.description: ask-tool: captured from Claude Code's question tool; spec: a question section of a spec.

session.description: The transcript id of the session that recorded the answer (brain decision answer in a session).

host_id.description: The desktop app's id of that session (CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_SESSION_ID), stamped by the brain commands (scale study gap 19); brain check refuses one that matches no session.

machine.description: The machine the stamp was written on ($BRAIN_HOST, else the host name), so brain check knows where its host_id can be checked.

other.description: Free text, when the owner wrote their own answer.

via.description: default: no answer 24 h after a low-stakes decision was asked, its recommendation taken (by: default).

default.description: Marked low-stakes when asked (brain decision ask --low-stakes, wi-brain-decision-default): the recommendation is applied at once, provisionally, and recorded as the answer by default once 'after' passes without one; brain check refuses the mark on keys, money, accounts, visibility, publication, rules, arming and scheduled tasks.

after.description: When it becomes final: 24 h after it was asked.

reviewed.description: The owner took note of the default (brain decision defaulted --seen).

read.description: The model in charge read the answer.

applied.description: The model in charge applied the answer (ADR, item props, spec).

host_id.description: The desktop app's id of that session (CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_SESSION_ID), stamped by the brain commands (scale study gap 19); brain check refuses one that matches no session.

machine.description: The machine the stamp was written on ($BRAIN_HOST, else the host name), so brain check knows where its host_id can be checked.

in.description: Where: ADR ids, item ids, spec sections.

session.description: The SR of the session that asked.

host_id.description: The desktop app's id of that session (CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_SESSION_ID), stamped by the brain commands (scale study gap 19); brain check refuses one that matches no session.

machine.description: The machine the stamp was written on ($BRAIN_HOST, else the host name), so brain check knows where its host_id can be checked.
